comments.author: eliptik
comments.body:
I used to play Haxball so much when I was a kid, and this game is super fun too! I think it has huge potential.

One thing I don't understand, though, is whether I'm playing against bots or real players. Also, the goal replays should be fixed because they sometimes get cut off halfway through.

replies.author: _Minos
replies.body:
Nice! 

For the goal replays, you're probably experiencing people voting to skip them (top right shows the count), which will cut them short. Rocket League style.

The bot ambiguity i'm in two minds about, but it's done on purpose during these early periods while there's not a large enough playerbase for matchmaking to match you consistently. I'm thinking to get rid of it / more explicitly mark bots once that has improved.

Truth is that this helps engagement, and as long as bots are fun to play against, i believe it's ok. Custom lobbies already mark bots clearly and allow disabling them.

replies.author: _Minos
replies.body:
I didn't give Astra any special tooling for the video. Just a couple replay links of goals i thought looked good for inspiration.

The rendering, visual design, audio matching, was all 100% delegated to Astra.
